name: Acceptance test 15 - public role trust (role-trust, fail-closed by design)
note: IAM-707: role-trust family not yet modeled. Principal:* + sts:AssumeRole with no Resource is the trust-policy shape; the engine FAILS CLOSED with UNSUPPORTED_POLICY_FAMILY and does NOT evaluate it as an identity policy (so it never emits a spurious broad-Resource finding for the omitted Resource). Encodes current design-blocked behavior.

designBlocked.followUp: queued as the immediate next feature (Oliver, 2026-08-22)
designBlocked.intended: critical: unrestricted role trust; the role's permissions remain unknown/out of scope; graph origin should represent EXTERNAL principals, not the subject of this policy.
